basis: The chart's x-axis displays only the years 2017, 2018, 2019, and 2020 (r1.O.1, r2.O.1), while the form's review timeframe explicitly states a 2013-2020 assessment (r1.O.4, r2.O.3). The plotted positive test rate rises monotonically across the displayed years, from approximately 5.6% in 2017 to 8.0% in 2020 (r1.O.2, r2.O.2). Because the chart only provides data for the 2017-2020 subset and lacks the 2013-2016 data required to verify an across-period increase, the rising trend in the displayed window supports a recent-upswing interpretation rather than a sustained-growth one. The visible upward pattern also contradicts a decline-focused review.
option_label: Route to continued monitoring for a more recent upward shift in positive test rate
